title: Pair Sum: Establish a Baseline
prerequisite: Lesson 1 and the ability to trace a loop.
hints: For each index i, test it with every later index j so the two indices are distinct and each unordered pair is checked once.
Use nested loops with j starting at i + 1. The number of tested pairs grows quadratically.
Return [i, j] when nums[i] + nums[j] equals target; return null after every distinct pair has been tested.
